title: 美国写字楼空置压力上升 商业地产估值重估
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Powerful arias may be sung from the stage of Chicago's civic opera, but a quieter drama is playing out in the floors above.
segments.zh: 芝加哥市民歌剧院舞台上或许正回荡着激昂的咏叹调，但楼上几层却上演着一出更安静的戏码。

segments.en: It involves half-empty offices, a troubled loan, and a building worth far less than it used to be.
segments.zh: 这出戏涉及半空的办公室、一笔问题贷款，以及一栋价值远不如前的建筑。

segments.en: Even for a building that's so architecturally and culturally historic, it shows that that's not quite enough to attract tenants.
segments.zh: 即便这栋建筑在建筑和文化上极具历史意义，也表明这还不足以吸引租户。

segments.en: It's a problem that's happening across the country as huge swaths of commercial real estate sit vacant, accruing massive amounts of debt.
segments.zh: 这个问题正在全美蔓延，大量商业地产空置，累积了巨额债务。

segments.en: Roughly $67 billion worth of loans are coming due either this year or next on office properties.
segments.zh: 今年或明年，约有670亿美元的贷款将到期，涉及办公物业。

segments.en: Is the U.S. undergoing a zombie office apocalypse? The problem started with the pandemic.
segments.zh: 美国是否正经历僵尸办公室的冲击？问题始于疫情。

segments.en: We saw offices empty out, we saw interest rates rise, and as a result, values have plummeted, wiping out investments for both equity investors and lenders across the board, touching banks, touching debt funds, everyone.
segments.zh: 我们看到办公室空置、利率上升，结果估值暴跌，权益市场参与者和贷款方的投入被抹去，波及银行、债务基金等所有人。

segments.en: For years, lenders crossed their fingers and hoped the good times would return. This was the extend and pretend financial strategy.
segments.zh: 多年来，贷款方祈祷好日子回归。这就是展期与假装策略。

segments.en: Extend and pretend is basically a practice where lenders, instead of foreclosing on properties where the values plummeted, they ignored the short-term valuations, and just simply decided to extend a loan in the hopes that perhaps values will rise again if people come back to the office or if interest rates fall.
segments.zh: 展期与假装基本上是贷款方的一种做法：对于估值暴跌的物业，他们不进行法拍，而是忽略短期估值，直接决定延长贷款，希望如果人们回到办公室或利率下降，估值或许会再次上升。

segments.en: But not enough office workers have returned. Work from home and other remote situations have stuck.
segments.zh: 但返回办公室的员工不够多。居家办公和其他远程情况已经持续。
